titleEn: Minimum Addition to Make Integer Beautiful
title: 使整数变美丽的最小增量
summary: 给定 n 和 target，求最小非负 x，使 n+x 的十进制数位和不超过 target。
insight: 若数位和过大，从个位起把当前低位整体进位到下一个十的倍数；这是修改当前最低尚未归零位的最小增量，重复直到数位和合格。
pitfalls: 返回的是增量而非最终数

solutions.title: 逐十进制位向上取整
solutions.idea: 逐步把低位归零以降低数位和。

code.java: class Solution { private int digitSum(long value){int sum=0;while(value>0){sum+=value%10;value/=10;}return sum;}public long makeIntegerBeautiful(long n,int target){long original=n,place=10;while(digitSum(n)>target){long remainder=n%place;if(remainder>0)n+=place-remainder;place*=10;}return n-original;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun makeIntegerBeautiful(nValue:Long,target:Int):Long{fun digitSum(valueInput:Long):Int{var value=valueInput;var sum=0;while(value>0){sum+=(value%10).toInt();value/=10};return sum};val original=nValue;var n=nValue;var place=10L;while(digitSum(n)>target){val remainder=n%place;if(remainder>0)n+=place-remainder;place*=10};return n-original} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int digitSum(long long value){int sum=0;while(value){sum+=value%10;value/=10;}return sum;}public:long long makeIntegerBeautiful(long long n,int target){long long original=n,place=10;while(digitSum(n)>target){long long remainder=n%place;if(remainder)n+=place-remainder;place*=10;}return n-original;} };
